column3: Stripped leading/trailing spaces from all text columns so identical values group together.
`BusinessTravel` held both 'Travel_Rarely' and 'TravelRarely' for the same category - merged into 'Travel_Rarely'.
Dropped rows that were identical in every column (keeping the first).
The same EmpID appeared more than once with conflicting values (e.g. different YearsWithCurrManager). An employee can only exist once, so the first record was kept.
Columns with a single value carry no analytical information: `EmployeeCount`, `Over18`, `StandardHours`.
`YearsWithCurrManager`: 57 blanks filled with median of employees with the same `YearsInCurrentRole` (corr. ~0.7), capped at `YearsAtCompany`; an `_Imputed` flag column keeps these rows identifiable.
Whole-number columns that were stored as decimals were converted to integers.
Checked tenure/age/income consistency and rebuilt `AgeGroup` and `SalarySlab` directly from Age and MonthlyIncome.
Extreme values were reviewed but kept: they are plausible (e.g. 40-year careers, senior salaries) and removing them would bias attrition analysis.

Added readable fields: `AttritionFlag`, `Status`, `TenureBand`, `DistanceBand`, `Education_Label`, `EnvironmentSatisfaction_Label`, `JobInvolvement_Label`, `JobSatisfaction_Label`, `RelationshipSatisfaction_Label`, `WorkLifeBalance_Label`, `PerformanceRating_Label`. Ordinal scores (1-4/1-5) are labelled using the standard IBM HR data dictionary (assumption).
